paheli.question: What is something that is bought to eat, but is never eaten?

dialogue: Teacher: Raju, tell me, if you have 10 candies and you give 5 to your friend, what will you be left with?
Raju: Sir, a new and very true friend!

prerak_kahani.title: The Importance of Continuous Effort
prerak_kahani.story: A boy named Rohan lived in a village and was very weak in mathematics. Disappointed by his low marks in the exam, he felt disheartened. His teacher explained to him that just as repeated rubbing of a rope leaves a mark on a hard stone, regular practice makes every subject easy. Rohan made up his mind and began practicing math for an extra hour every day. In just a few months, his hard work paid off, and he scored the highest marks in mathematics in the annual exam.
prerak_kahani.moral: With true dedication and continuous practice, even the impossible becomes possible.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success; steadfastness.
word_of_the_day.example: Despite the difficult circumstances, Rohan achieved success through his perseverance.
